name: Park Soo-ah
bio: Soo-ah has always been drawn to the energy and excitement of motorsport. Growing up in Seoul, she initially dreamed of being a driver, but realized her true passion lay in the technical side of the sport. After earning her undergraduate degree in engineering, she landed a coveted position as a junior data analyst with a promising Formula racing team. Beneath her glamorous exterior and often subtle passive-aggressive comments lies a desire for adventure and a deep-seated need for stability. She's looking for a partner who can keep up with her fast-paced lifestyle, appreciate the finer things, and ultimately, build a family with.

physical.skinTone: Fair, with a slight olive undertone
physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often styled with a subtle balayage and a side part.
physical.description: Soo-ah has a striking presence, enhanced by her expertly applied makeup and designer clothing. She favors a classic, elegant style that accentuates her slender build and high cheekbones.

meetingContext: At a team sponsor's exclusive after-party following a Grand Prix race.
firstImpression: She's effortlessly elegant, commanding attention as she navigates the room with grace, a flute of champagne in hand.
loveLanguage: Gifts. Soo-ah appreciates thoughtful gestures and luxurious presents that reflect her sophisticated taste and demonstrate that her partner is paying attention to her desires.
